system.description:
Grabbing ahold of your weapon and infusing it with your chakra makes each shot something that rarely misses its mark. For the duration, each time you roll an Ammunition Die as part of a Taijutsu attack, you can choose to instead reduce the size of your ammunition die by 1 step. If you do, the affected creature that you deal [Weapon damage] to becomes Artemis Marked until the end of your next turn.

| Artemis’s Ammo – Artemis Marked / A Creature that is Artemis Marked radiates with a soft green mist that only the creature that inflicted the mark can see. An Artemis Marked creature takes +4 damage from the first instance of Bludgeoning, piercing or slashing damage it takes each turn. |
